description: Push a transient frame to chat sockets through OpenVibe.Chat: news cards, donation and goal cards, alerts and channel sounds, media queue state, redemptions, vibe-coding events, voice channel lists, system and restart notices, and call invites to one person. Nothing is stored; Chat validates the frame and its target (a stream, a channel, an owner's streams, global chat, everyone or one person) and broadcasts it once per idempotency key. Loopback only, first-party service token (Live's principal today); never granted to an app or delegated to an agent.
